notes: Strip b (x 1800-3900, picks to ~1500-4200). Otelia Street: the 33 ft N-S street at x~2298 between Otelia (y 1313) and the private drive (y~1805) is printed only 'ST.'; it reads as Otelia Street turning south (both 33 ft, plain L corner) - doubtful, could be a separately named street. Evanswood Place (printed EVANSWOOD PLACE / EVANSWOOD ... PL.) is one street: narrow curved arm from Otelia at y 1532, south at x~2606, then E-W at y~1815 to Cornell Place; it jogs ~120 px south across Cornell (west leg centre y 1822, east leg y 1942), so two Cornell T's. Morrison Avenue (printed MORRISON ... AVE.) runs from Ludlow's corner south to Dixmyth; Ludlow turns from S to ESE at the Morrison junction (point used as Ludlow's corner). Howell Avenue jogs at Morrison: west leg (printed HOWELL AVE., ~20 ft between lines, a '15' printed near it) centre y 4300, east leg (50 ft) centre y 4269 - two T points. Christiana Street (y 5408) and Lowell Avenue (y 5368) meet Morrison 40 px apart, not as one crossing. Julia Ann Street (west) and Bates Avenue (east) meet Morrison at the same point: name change across Morrison, recorded as two entries at one point. Christiana/Eveline is an L corner (Christiana's west end, Eveline's north end). Eveline ends at Julia Ann. Wood: printed 'WOOD' on this strip, 'AVE.' further east at x~5200 - written Wood Avenue (check against strip c). Not streets / not recorded: private drives (PRIVATE DRIVE, JOHN MORRISON drive) between Otelia and Ludlow; a 5 ft walk (grey band) from McAlpin south at x~2320 to y 1155, east, then south at x~3470 to Evanswood; a 12 ft strip of double property tints at x~3400 between Ludlow and Howell (no name, treated as lot line). McAlpin Avenue (60 ft, centre y~270, north side clipped by plate edge) has no crossings between x 1500 and 4200. Whitfield Avenue (x~4390) and Hedgerow Street (x~4330) lie just outside the 4200 margin and are not picked here. Dixmyth's south line coincides with the plate clip edge. Cornell Place north of Evanswood is a narrow (~25 ft) curving arm ending at a lot line; south of Evanswood it is 50 ft (lines x 3937-4012) and runs on to Ludlow. Lafayette-side diagonal from the Otelia 'ST.' south end SW to Ludlow is printed PRIVATE (60 ft): not recorded.
